lead: A stale `target/debug/nvs.exe` answers `E0405: Core\Foo has no member named bar` for a member you just registered, which reads as a registration bug rather than as a stale binary.
body: The class name resolves without the registry (`QName::is_reserved_global_class`), so the sentence is the one a missing `address()` arm or `CLASSES` row would produce. The binary's package is `nvs-cli`, not `nvs`: `cargo build -p nvs` fails with "package ID specification `nvs` did not match any packages" and leaves the old executable in place, so refresh with `cargo build --bin nvs` or plain `cargo build`.
